'''Dark Shadow Warrior''' was an identity adopted by the [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] individuals throughout their conquests following the [[destruction of Zhell]]. At some point amidst their warring, a [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] eruption brought devastation upon the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Great Zhell]]. The plume of ash rose into the [[Atmosphere/Legends|sky]], and cast a giant shadow over the [[High place|land of the Taungs]] for two [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]]. They viewed the shadow cast as a symbol of their destiny.<ref name="SotE" />
